input.text: Why was my Lab conversation not saved?

transcript.text: Why was my Lab conversation not saved?

If you mean **asking in Lab to “save this conversation” as a Notes summary**, the current configuration explains why that request would not trigger a save: **recipient detection (Jev) is not configured**. Jev also detects conversation-save requests outside Welcome.

The other dependency is configured: **Notes settings** selects **openai-direct** with **Low** effort to generate summaries. That provider also handles note compression and web page and YouTube imports. I haven’t verified that its remote requests succeed, and the available logs do not show a specific summary-save failure.

You can save a summary without Jev: open the Lab session’s sidebar menu and choose **Save summary**. To enable natural-language save requests, configure recipient detection under **Settings → Session settings**.

If instead you mean **the conversation itself disappeared from Recent**, that is a different issue: stored chat history does not depend on Jev or Notes summaries. Which happened—no note appeared, or the Lab chat itself is missing?

I haven’t changed any settings.
